issues.title: Design and implement UI for waiver actions on the individual training profile
issues.description:
### User Story
```gherkin
As a Layer/Org Manager or Supervisor
I want a clear and intuitive interface to waive, bulk-waive, and reverse trainings
So that I can manage training exceptions confidently without confusion
```

### Acceptance Criteria
```gherkin
Feature: Waiver Management UI

  Scenario: Waiver controls are clearly presented
    Given I am an authorized user viewing an individual's training profile
    Then waiver actions are clearly visible and labeled per training
    And a bulk "Waive All Remaining" action is accessible

  Scenario: Confirmation prevents accidental actions
    When I trigger a waiver or reversal
    Then I am prompted with a confirmation dialog before the action completes
    And I can optionally provide a reason

  Scenario: Status is visually distinct
    Given trainings have varying statuses
    Then "Waived" trainings are visually distinguishable from active/required ones
```

issues.title: Record and display audit history for all waiver and reversal actions
issues.description:
### User Story
```gherkin
As a Layer/Org Manager, Supervisor, or Auditor
I want every waiver and reversal action recorded with who, when, and why
So that there is full traceability and accountability for training exceptions
```

### Acceptance Criteria
```gherkin
Feature: Waiver Audit Trail

  Scenario: Waiver action is logged
    Given a training has been waived
    Then the system records the actor's identity, timestamp, and any provided reason

  Scenario: Reversal action is logged
    Given a waiver has been reversed
    Then the system records the actor's identity and timestamp

  Scenario: View training history
    Given a training has had waiver or reversal actions
    When I view the training's history
    Then I can see who performed each action, when, and any reason provided
```

issues.title: Allow authorized users to reverse a previously waived training
issues.description:
### User Story
```gherkin
As a Layer/Org Manager or Supervisor
I want to reverse a waiver on a training
So that I can restore the training requirement if it was waived in error or circumstances change
```

### Acceptance Criteria
```gherkin
Feature: Reverse Training Waiver

  Background:
    Given I am authenticated as a Layer/Org Manager or Supervisor
    And I am viewing an individual's training profile

  Scenario: Successfully reverse a waiver
    Given a training is currently in "Waived" status
    When I select the waived training
    And I choose "Reverse Waiver"
    And I confirm the reversal action
    Then the training status returns to its prior active/required state
    And the training is once again counted against outstanding/required trainings

  Scenario: Reverse waiver option only available for waived trainings
    Given a training is not in "Waived" status
    When I view that training
    Then the "Reverse Waiver" option is not available
```

issues.title: Allow authorized users to waive all remaining trainings for an individual
issues.description:
### User Story
```gherkin
As a Layer/Org Manager or Supervisor
I want to waive all remaining incomplete trainings for an individual at once
So that I can efficiently clear multiple training exceptions in a single action
```

### Acceptance Criteria
```gherkin
Feature: Waive All Remaining Trainings

  Background:
    Given I am authenticated as a Layer/Org Manager or Supervisor
    And I am viewing an individual's training profile

  Scenario: Successfully waive all remaining trainings
    Given the individual has one or more incomplete trainings
    When I choose "Waive All Remaining Trainings"
    And I optionally enter a reason
    And I confirm the bulk waiver action
    Then all incomplete trainings for that individual are set to "Waived"
    And none of the waived trainings count against outstanding/required trainings

  Scenario: No remaining trainings to waive
    Given the individual has no incomplete trainings
    When I view the waiver options
    Then the "Waive All Remaining Trainings" option is unavailable or disabled
```

issues.title: Allow authorized users to waive a single training for an individual
issues.description:
### User Story
```gherkin
As a Layer/Org Manager or Supervisor
I want to waive a specific training for an individual
So that I can handle a single-training exception efficiently
```

### Acceptance Criteria
```gherkin
Feature: Waive Single Training

  Background:
    Given I am authenticated as a Layer/Org Manager or Supervisor
    And I am viewing an individual's training profile

  Scenario: Successfully waive a single training
    Given the individual has an assigned training that is not yet completed
    When I select the specific training
    And I choose "Waive Training"
    And I optionally enter a reason
    And I confirm the waiver action
    Then the selected training status is updated to "Waived"
    And the training no longer counts against outstanding/required trainings

  Scenario: Attempt to waive an already completed training
    Given the individual has a training already marked "Completed"
    When I view that training
    Then the "Waive Training" option is unavailable or appropriately handled
```

issues.title: Restrict training waiver actions to Layer/Org Managers and Supervisors
issues.description:
### User Story
```gherkin
As a system administrator
I want waiver capabilities limited to authorized roles
So that only Layer/Org Managers and Supervisors can modify training waiver status
```

### Acceptance Criteria
```gherkin
Feature: Waiver Role-Based Access Control

  Scenario: Authorized role sees waiver options
    Given I am authenticated as a Layer/Org Manager or Supervisor
    When I view an individual's training profile
    Then I see options to waive and reverse waivers

  Scenario: Unauthorized role is blocked
    Given I am a user without Layer/Org Manager or Supervisor permissions
    When I view an individual's training profile
    Then I do not see any waiver-related options
    And any direct attempt to perform a waiver action is denied with an authorization error
```
